method: tip gap across the jaw ends, owner's calipers. Lookup = piecewise-linear interpolation through the measured points, with zero gap assumed at the closed stop. A one-parameter hinge model (gap = L*sin(theta)) fitted the first two points within 0.2 mm but missed the third by 3.3 mm, so it is not used.

fit.assumption: zero gap at the closed stop, unverified; lowest commandable opening is raw 1357 (servo limit 1323 + 3 deg margin)
